sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production portrait4:5travel puzzle PAINTED CLEAN BACKGROUND. Scene: A lantern-lit courtyard prepared for an evening gathering. Part placements for later composition: a small scene-specific pennant or kite tail at normalised rect [0.14, 0.1, 0.19, 0.19]; one hanging painted lantern or festival ornament at normalised rect [0.66, 0.18, 0.15, 0.19]; a curling ribbon tied to a scene prop at normalised rect [0.42, 0.43, 0.16, 0.18]; a small flower-garland section at normalised rect [0.1, 0.7, 0.21, 0.15]; a loose scene-matching fabric streamer at normalised rect [0.72, 0.64, 0.16, 0.23]. The painting must remain attractive and complete underneath those parts. Warm cocoa-brown wooden courtyard architecture dominates this lantern-lit evening scene. Glowing amber lanterns and muted colourful fabric are accents. Provide a few real hanging cords across the courtyard, an empty cord where one separately painted lantern will hang, potted flowers and garland supports. No people, lettering, logos or recognizable place. Use portrait4:5 composition. sources.name: atlas
sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one production transparent RGBA sprite atlas for the unique scene "A lantern-lit courtyard prepared for an evening gathering". Match a premium cozy storybook painted mobile puzzle: rich dimensional gouache-like digital painting, delicate brushed pigment, believable natural details, softly warm upper-left sunlight, tactile materials and clean silhouettes. No vector simplification, no photographic collage, no geometric filler. The finished background is a gently elevated three-quarter view painted composition. All objects share that light and perspective. This is an asset sheet, not a scene: true transparent alpha, no RGB colored matte, NO frame or grid lines, NO cell border or rectangular shadow. Strict 3 columns by 2 rows, 3:2 landscape image. Each of the five objects must be isolated INSIDE the central 60% of its own cell, leaving at least 20% empty transparent gutter on ALL FOUR SIDES. Nothing may touch or cross any cell boundary; steam and fine strands must also stay inside those gutters. Bottom-right sixth cell must be perfectly empty transparent, including no faint artifacts. Five cells read left to right: top-left one small warm glowing amber paper lantern with dark bronze cap and a short top hanging loop, alpha glow tight to silhouette; top-middle a narrow burgundy cloth pennant hanging from a top corner, no text; top-right a sprig of small coral-pink courtyard flowers with dark green leaves and a tapered bottom stem; bottom-left a short dark olive vine curling to right from a narrow bottom stem; bottom-middle one short string of three distinct tiny golden marigold flowers hanging vertically from a top thread. Paint exactly these five separate details; no labels, typography, scenery, containers, confetti, or extra objects. Preserve detailed natural alpha edges and translucent painted material where specified.
